I love this product. I've used it for several years and the results are are great.
I loved the multi action super b serum but it's been discontinued. This is thick and sticky after it dries and make my makeup look strange.
Amazed at how good this product is. I saw improvement in just a week of use. Highly recommend. Of course, there are several other Strivection products I love as well!

avis.titre: Yes, it was a first time purchase, and it is a good buy.
avis.texte: The similar product was discontinued, so I took a chance on this new one with some of the same features.
It was a moisturizer that was drying! The dispenser is weird and inefficient-at one point only the clear side was coming out. It felt acidic on my skin. Nope. Shocked by great reviews!

I put this product on every morning after I've brushed my teeth. The two lotions work wonderful together. It leaves my face soft and feeling fresh and last all day. My only complaint, is the silver on the bottle comes off and if it gets on your fingers. Sometimes it looks like you put glitter on your face.
I believe what other reviews r saying, im hoping it works for me. I didnt start using it

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again.
avis.texte: My skin glows and is so much smoother and brighter. So glad the Technician suggested it a few months ago.
I'm seeing a differences in my skin after two weeks of using the product loving it 😍

avis.titre: Disappointed in Shipping Experience — Hoping for Resolution
avis.texte: I'm a longtime fan of your products and have always trusted your brand for quality skincare. However, I'm really disappointed with my recent experience. I paid for overnight shipping expecting my order to arrive promptly, but not only did it arrive late, the entire order has now gone missing. I had really been looking forward to trying the products and was counting on them for an upcoming event. It's frustrating to pay extra for faster shipping and still be left empty-handed. I reached out to your customer service but haven't received a satisfying solution yet. As someone who genuinely loves your products and has supported your brand, I would deeply appreciate it if you could help make this right. A replacement order or a few complimentary products would go a long way in restoring my trust and ensuring I continue to recommend StriVectin to others. Looking forward to hearing from you soon.
I like how this feels when I put it on my face each night before I put my moisturizer on.

Over the course of a couple of weeks I did an informal comparison of Strivectin and another highly rated Hyaluronic acid, and found that Strivectin seemed to be more effective at diminishing my smile lines . I liked it enough that I've repurchased it.
I love the product, but would like just one solution, not two.

After the first week, I saw some distinct improvement in the texture of my skin. I've used Strivectin products for a few years now and have been satisfied with the results. This is the first time I've used the hyaluronic acid. I was a bit nervous but pleased with how my skin has taken another step up. I turn 63 this week, but just a few days ago someone complimented me on my skin and when I asked them, they thought I was around 38 or 39!
Works great, but the pump doesn't deliver the white crème portion until several squirts of serum have to be wasted. Too expensive to waste !!
Hydration Multiplier Hyaluronic Acid is my perfect pairing with the Hyaluronic Tripeptide Gel-Cream. Really, these two products are my first steps each morning. Thank you, StriVectin!
This is great hyaluronic acid cream. Only a few small pumps is all you need. It's very moisturizing, easy to use, and leaves your face and neck feeling hydrated.
Product dispenser doesn't work. The left side comes out and the right side does not. I did exactly what the instructions said. I also bought two hyperlift instant eye fix and they didn't work either.
This is the best product I found to use for Hyaluronic Acid. It works wonderful.
I was anticipating a typical serum, which is typically followed up with a moisturizer. This pump bottle has both. My 46 year old skin has never felt better - much less in February, in New England!
It feels like you are giving your face a drink of water, especially in the dry winter months.
This is the BEST moisturizer I have ever used. You have to be careful to push in the center of the 2 chambers to get an equal amount of both.
Feels good on skin. Bought it for dry skin and to add hyaluronic acid to skin care.
I really like the way it makes my skin look & feel. Really works

I ordered this in November as part of a Christmas present (for myself) and the bottle DOES NOT pump properly. I sent an email to customer service and the representative suggested a couple of things I should try and if it does not work she requested video of pumping it to see it's only coming out on one side and the numbers printed on the bottom. I have provided this information by responding and forwarding my email to customer service about 4 times since 1/1 and no one has responded. So I guess I'm left with really expensive product that does not work properly. Save your money, don't bother getting it.
Thy hyaluronic multiplier makes my face feel hydrated and fresh. I use it twice a day and am happy with the results .

I've used hyaluronic in the little vials and the consistency is like water where as the Strivectin Hydration Multiplier Hyaluronic Acid Serum is combined with a lotion that gives it a more creamy texture. Need to keep using to see results as I am new to Strivectin
Love this product! My skin is super hydrated, glowing and smooth!
This product is amazing. Did not realize how much my skin needed hydration, as I have been using another product every day!

avis.titre: 1OZ not received as claimed - i would give zero stars if ...
avis.texte: i took apart the chambers in this product and you barely get anything in this!!! There is no way you get even close to an ounce out of this product. I would get my money back if possible. i wish i could add pictures to this post.
This product is helping to fade dark spots and reducing wrinkles
I use this once a week at night as an exfoliant. I find that my skin looks very youthful and Improved every time I use it. Also, it smells very good.
Fees great on my skin but I don't really care for the pump container.
Ordered my products on August 19, 2024. They charged my credit card but have Never received my products. Its delayed AGAIN!

The Hydration Multiplier really helps my skin both in reducing the look of lines, but also some skin discolorations. I've used it for about a year, and along with other StriVectin products, I've decided this is the line that I'm sticking with.
I love this product! Great as an undercover for my am and pm products

I tried this in place of my usual (much more expensive) serum after trying a sample of it. I liked the way it made my skin feel and the quantity of product is more for less money than my go-to, so I thought I'd get more bang for my buck. Not the case. The packaging design is not great, you cannot get both serums to dispense equally with most pumps, and I didn't feel that it did anything extraordinary for my skin. It also ran out completely in just a little over a month, vs my go-to product which lasts much longer even though the size is smaller in ounces. The packaging is just not great, leaving me wondering how much product I ultimately threw away simply because of the poor pump design. Not a bad product but I wouldn't buy it again.

I was looking for a hydrating serum that was thin enough to spread easily, avoiding tugging on the skin during application. The StriVectin customer service rep recommended this product. I like the feel of this serum. It moisturizes and absorbs without being greasy. Minimal to no fragrance which is good.

Nice product with very light fragrance. It took several applications to get both pumps to work simultaneously, but now they both deliver product. Light serum that seems to moisturize well. Easy to apply and spread without tugging the skin. Have only used about 2 weeks.
Excellent product. It smooths out the skin, but the product finishes quick i you use it for day and night.
This is the best hydration product I have ever used. This is a must have!

Provides a lush cool soft moisturizing feel. I love the way my face feels and looks so refreshed after using the Hydration Multiplier Hyaluronic Acid Serum. Not only does it protect my skin it helps my foundation glide on.
I was feeling as if my 73 yr old skin was 90+ years old. It was very dry and felt very tight. This has helped very much. My skin feels and looks youngish now.😉

I have been using the product for about 10 days. It goes on smooth and leaves my skin feeling soft and slightly hydrated. I definitely do not care for the delivery system of the product. I wish it came mixed together. I feel like I am getting an uneven distribution of the product and I am also having to use more than I have with other multi formula products.
Quite good but takes many applications and you have to mix in your fingers in stead of getting one serum...it is awkward. Quite costly.

I love new products from Strivectin and this serum knocks it out of the park. My skin feels so soft. I layer it with the nighttime/daytime lotions and/or creams from Strivectin. I am 65 looking young.
I use this product day and night under other strivectin products. My skin feels hydrated. Works well under foundation.
I have added this new product to my routine and it is a game Changer. A crucial part los my skin care routine. I have seen the results and feel that my skin is more hydrated.
I really like this serum and can tell that my skin looks better.
This is a game changer for my routine and I've gotten several friends hooked on it too

I love this product. I originally received a free sample, and liked it so much that I bought the bottle, one for myself and one for my mother. It seems to plump up the skin and that seems to soften fine lines and give an overall fresher appearance.

I used it in the mornings and evenings, the result is so satisfying. I feel much better after using it. My skin is softer and hydrated. Shipping was fast and good. I really recommend if you have a dry skin. I really love it!

I never ever take the time to leave a review. Like ever. I think this might be my first review I've ever left about a product. This serum is absolutely amazing. I verbally say "aaaah" every time I put it on my face. It feels SO luxurious, and my 16-year-old daughter's friend commented the other day on how young I looked (out of the blue). I haven't heard that in 100 years, or maybe ever lol. I am sold for life!!!
I love the hydrated it plumps up and smoothes out my skin. I layer it over riveting vitamin c - retinol and peptides cream.
I like the texture and the way it adds a nice glow to clean skin, but i don't know about long- term effects.
I do like this product, my only complaint is it is kind of difficult to dispense.
Love this product!! I know I am always getting high quality product with StriVectin!
I have been using your products for years now. I have retired now, and I try to get the best deals so that I can continue using your products. Thank you for having your sales.

I am 71 years old?and I started using this product for about three weeks and I see a big difference in the texture of my skin. I would recommend every day, it's wonderful.❤️
This is now firmly in my daily arsenal and I've gotten many of my friends hooked on it as well!

For my skin, this product is a tortoise. At first I thought nothing was happening. I realized the hydration multiplier serum was the only change I had made to my care regimen. My advice is to try it and stick with it. You will see changes!
Love this product, I'm 73 and it makes my skin look and feel wonderful!!
I use this along with strivectin products and all I could say is their line of products really do work. Very happy with the improvement to my fine lines and under eye bags.

I received a sample of the StriVectin dual serum from Ulta Beauty. The sample had two sections of serums that you mix together. I only had enough product for a one-time use, but I could tell that the cream was very hydrating and made my skin feel silky smooth. It had a lovely clean scent. I did not experience any kind of irritation. I noticed the lines around my eyes were less noticeable. I even put the serum on my neck, and it felt like satin. I had no irritation on my neck either. I'm interested in picking up a full size.
Was so happy I tried this hydration lotion. My skin hasn't looked better and it doesn't feel heavy like other moisturizers

1. It took a week of shaking, turning upside down to get one side of product to come out, so that's 7 days of waste. 2. I didn't experience the plumping others describe 3. No difference in fines lines anywhere on my face 4. Vitamin C serum better 5. I will use until depleted but not purchase again.
I don't get allergic reactions to anything but this made me break out in hives on my face and made my eyes really swollen

I'm currently going through chemo and it's very hard on your skin and also made my eczema flare up . The first time I used it, it was instant results. It doesn't take a lot, one pump covers my face and neck. I wish they made it in a body lotion.
I love this! This is a great addition to my other products i use.
I received my order today the 21 of February , used it the first time realized my pump dispenser wasn't working for the cream only for the clear liquid.
I will never go without this. I just love this stuff. Instant moisture. It really helped around my lip area. Best product ever!:heart:️
I have never been so impressed by a product. It makes my face feel soooo soft! And you don't have to wait weeks to feel it. It is truly AMAZING!
Can't get enough of how great my skin is after using. Most fine lines have minimized in appearance.
I was given a sample of this with my last purchase and I absolutely love it!! We live in NM where moisture is rarely seen!! It instantly hydrated my face!!!

I live in a very dry climate where hydration focused skincare is key to having healthy looking and feeling skin. This serum from StriVectin was a great addition to my routine. Upon first use my skin felt good and hydrated. After a week of use I noticed my face felt more plump and looked glowy and radiant. The bottle is fairly large and the dual chamber pump is fun to use. Overall a good serum for anyone looking for a boost of moisture. This product was gifted to me by StriVectin.

It goes on smoothly but can feel a bit oily after sleeping with it on. It may be that it might not be for my skin. It didn't necessarily hurt my skin health. It may work for others!! I was not a fan of the smell. complimentary from strivectin

StriVectin multi-action hydration multiplier is a major upgrade from my normal product. My skin is immediately hydrated, soothed, and looks healthier overall. I am noticing a visible improvement in my fine lines around my eyes, as well as a plumper appearance all over. Gifted by StriVectin in exchange for my honest opinion.

I was gifted this Hydration Multiplier Hyaluronic Acid Serum complimentary from StriVectin for my honest review. I was quite happy with the results. Although it is quite early, my skin seems more hydrated. I feel like I have been having "good" skin days with this stuff. My skin is more supple and I feel like my makeup sits better on my face because of it. I would recommend and I will continue to use it.

This product was gifted by strivectin in exchange for my review. Serum is separated I two chambers. I enjoyed the texture and the mild smell of the serum. It absorbed fast into my skin and kept it hydrate
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I loved the texture of the two liquids. Serum has a mild pleasant smell. My skin felt hydrated and looked smooth all day.

This Hydration Multiplier Hyaluronic Acid Serum is complimentary from StriVectin. I love the husky tonic acid ingredient which super hydrating and easy to apply. It works great on my dry skin. Highly recommended!

avis.titre: I love the formula of this serum
avis.texte: I received this product gifted By to give my honest opinion. For me hyaluronic acid is something that I love and this product has helped my skin stay hydrated and radiant, I like the texture because it is absorbed quickly and I continue applying my other creams, I love this formula. I recommend this serum

This product is gifted to me from Strivectin in exchange of my honest review. I've been dealing with a very dry skin lately, and this product really helped my skin to get the hydration it needs. The fact that it has 7 Types of Hyaluronic Acid just really amazed me. My skin looks more plump and healthier. This product is really amazing.

avis.titre: Deep hydrated moisturizer for this cold weather
avis.texte: This unique futuristic looking bottle is packed full of Hyaluronic acid, Polyglutamic acid and five different types of Ceramide, specifically formulated for aging skin. It helps with evening out the skin texture, deeply hydrated and repair skin barrier. The weather this year is harsh and my current moisturizer didn't really does a good job of locking in moisture, I had to layer multiple thicker cream to helps combat the dry air from both cold weather and heater. I tried this serum and it's amazingly hydrated. My skin is much more plump after I woke up every morning. Besides hydration, I have not noticed any other difference, I will need to follow up a couple of weeks later.

This serum is special! It has two textures, the transparent essence and the white lotion work together, and the effect is very good! Very moisturizing, easy to spread and absorb! Very satisfied with the moisturizing effect!

This serum is very effective in moisturizing and moisturizing! When squeezed out, it has two textures: essence and lotion, but both are very delicate, easy to spread, and very easy to absorb. When used together, the effect is very moisturizing, not sticky, and very refreshing and comfortable!
I received this wonderful serum for free in exchange for my honest feedback. I absolutely love this serum. I have made it apart of my nightly routine. I definitely recommend using this product.

I received this product gifted by strivectin in exchange for my honest review. I am 48 years old with dry skin. I live in a northern climate so winter is especially hard on my skin. I tried the serum as part of my regular routine for 2 weeks and I saw real results in terms of hydration and overall improved texture. My face looked more glowy and healthier. I will make this a part of my skincare going forward.

I have only used it for about a week but I do feel that it gives my skin a beautiful glow and plumpness. There is a slight scent but its not overwhelming or irritating. I will say the component is a little annoying cause you have to push it just right to get the product to equally distribute. I have been using it at night and it does not cause other serums or moisturizers to pill. This was gifted by strivectin but these are my true opinions

This serum was gifted by Strivectin. Hyaluronic acid is one of my favorite ingredients in skincare products. So I knew I had to try this product out! Because my skin is oily, I try to find products that absorbs well into my skin and boosts hydration. The pump packaging is great and I see great improvements to my skin texture. It's lightweight and easy to combine with other products I use and no breakouts as I incorporated this into my routine. Don't hesitate to give this product a try!

Complimentary from Strivectin for review. StriVectin's Hydration Multiplier might be a holy grail moment for those of us with dry, wintry skin! This hyaluronic acid serum is packed with skin loving ingredients to hydrate dull skin, improve skin barrier, and promote a healthy, dewy glow. My skin feels softer and healthier with this is my skincare routine. I'm noticing some of the darker patches I get in the winter starting to clear up after just a few uses.

I received this product for free for review. Gifted by Strivectin. I am reviewing the Strivectin Hydration Multiplier Hyaluronic Acid Serum. Right away, I noticed an instant hydration and it glides on so smooth and absorbs well without feeling too greasy or oily. I am hopeful that adding this to my nightly routine with help with fine lines that I've been noticing as I'm aging. On the short term, I have noticed my face less flaky and dry even in the dry winter season so I'm happy with being able to add this product in.

I was gifted by Strivectin hydration multiplier, hyaluronic acid serum in exchange for my honest review. First let's talk about the bottle it's amazing. I love the side by side feature. My skin has been so dry this winter and I noticed a difference two days after beginning use!
I love Hyaluronic acid serum. Usually in the morning, my skin gets dry after overnight Retinoid application. This keeps my skin not dry anymore.

gifted bystrivectin Receive this product as a gift from STRIVECTIN I had been wanting to try this dream for a long time and it arrived in a season that is really needed since it is very cold, obviously drying out the skin on my face more than normal, and what a good product 12 hours with skin that looks radiant I have hydrated it. If you suffer from dry skin like me, you have to try it. I even eliminated several products that you previously used because this one made up for them in my skincare routine.

This serum was gifted to me by StriVectin in exchange for my honest opinion. This Hydration Multiplier Hyaluronic Acid Serum makes my skin feel so nourished and soft. I especially like to use it as part of my evening skincare routine. If I put it on at night I wake with hydrated and refreshed skin. I am hopeful that with regular use this serum may help fight against signs of aging. The hydrating power alone will be beneficial against aging. I love the design of the packaging and that it combines two serums at once, saving me an extra step.

I have received this product for free, it was gifted by strivectin. My opinion is that this serum has a nice blurring effect. My acne scars did look smoother and smaller. My face looked instantly moisturized. My only complaint is that my face did look oily at the end of the day.

This is a wonderful hyaluronic acid serum. I love that it pumps two serums at once. I've been using it for a week plus now and it has helped make my skin so soft, smooth and radiant!! I was gifted by Strivectin this Hydration Multiplier Hyaluronic Acid Serum complimentary in exchange for my truthful review.

avis.titre: Leaves your skin looking bright and refeshed
avis.texte: This is such a fabulous product, my skin tends to be on the dry side, and this product helps it glow takes away the dullness! I will definitely be ordering it again, and it will become part of my daily skincare routine.

I recently tried the Hydration Multiplier Hyaluronic Acid Serum (which was gifted by StriVectin in exchange for my review), and I'm genuinely impressed with the results. From the moment I applied it, my skin felt instantly hydrated and plump. The serum has a lightweight texture that absorbs quickly, leaving no greasy residue. With consistent use, I noticed a visible improvement in the overall smoothness and radiance of my skin. This product has become a staple in my skincare routine, and I highly recommend it for anyone seeking a boost of hydration and a radiant complexion.

I used the serum for ten days. wrinkles around the eyes have decreased, the skin looks fresher and healthier. The serum reduces the appearance of wrinkles and does not dry out or irritate the skin. skin is hydrated and radiant glow. this product gifted by Strivectin complimentary for my honest review .
My skin is softer so are the lines. I'm 81 so I know lines!!!
These products have made a big difference in the way my skin looks and feels, have gotten a lot of compliments

This is a really nice product and something that I will definitely purchase in the future. I am so grateful that this was gifted by strivectin in exchange for my honest opinion. My face is combination skin, my t-zone tends to be oily, but the rest of my face is dry. This hydrated my skin so nicely and worked well on my oily spots. I have some faint fine lines around my eyes, mouth and forhead and it helped lessen their appearance. This helps make my skin look nice and fresh. Very happy with this.

This was a really nice serum, far better than I really expected. At a first glance the packaging is beautiful, really catches your attention. The product itself is great, no sticky feeling when I apply it. Would definitely recommend. Gifted by Strivectin
